summary.tldr: Requires the Minister for Women and Gender Equality to report on how bills and amendments may affect women, especially Indigenous women.
what_it_does: Requires the minister to examine every government bill introduced in Parliament and table a statement on its possible effects on women, especially Indigenous women, within two sitting days.
Requires the minister to examine other bills that reach committee stage in their house of origin and table a statement within 10 sitting days after referral.
Requires the minister to table a statement on amendments made in the house where a bill starts, within seven sitting days after the other house receives the bill.
Requires each statement to be posted on the department’s website no later than the day after it is tabled.
Applies these new duties only to bills introduced six months or more after royal assent.
who_it_affects: Minister for Women and Gender Equality
summary.background: The bill amends the Department for Women and Gender Equality Act by adding new duties to examine bills and amendments for their effects on women.
